name: PPA Custody Adapter
scope: Testnet-only custody mechanics for an NTEST-style ERC-20. A deterministic GenLayer authorizer reads a live PPA Core EXECUTED consequence, binds payment/account/currency/recipient/amount, and authorizes an exact-intent EVM custody settlement. Not part of the released PPA composition.

genlayerWrites: initialize(owner, core_address, adapter_address, vault_address, token_address, currency, max_ttl_seconds)

canonicalInput.ttl_seconds: positive decimal string, <= configured max_ttl and <= 604800
canonicalInput.core_binding: consequence.proposal_id, payment_id, decision_id, adapter_caller, requested_recipient, requested_amount, created_at
canonicalInput.amount_convention: The PPA amount string is interpreted as the custody token's base-unit amount in v0.1. Assets with human decimal units require a later decimals-aware capability version.

canonicalOutput.AUTHORIZED: authorization message emitted to the vault via EthSend; vault intent exists only after finality
canonicalOutput.REJECTED: Core/config/state/vault refusal persisted with a stable reason_code

owns: owner, Core, adapter, vault, max TTL, pause configuration

negativeBoundary.noArbitraryEvmCall: Only the configured vault's authorize is sent; only its paused/allowedTokens views are read.

composition.label: testnet custody extension
composition.note: The existing ppa composedUnits are unchanged. This capability must not be read as a released PPA component.

unsupported: decimals-aware amount conversion (base-unit convention only in v0.1)
migration of existing PPA composition claims

evidence.local: PASS: 8 glsim tests, 4/4 canonical vectors, 21 Foundry tests, genvm-lint validation
evidence.live: PASS: live Phase 1 custody slice on Bradbury (chain 4221). Evidence: convergence/deployment/ppa-custody-live-2026-10-20.json (authorizer 0x69beC2d7635b387Bc1208ce76952ee1dD0Fb85DA, vault 0xAA967ab46129935EF17F07a2D95Aa2cC97A9C38D, settle tx 0x3696f469..., vault NTEST 500->400e18, recipient 0->100e18; negatives: wrong-currency, expired-before-finality, unauthorized-authorize, paused-settle, wrong-token/recipient/amount, settle-replay, authorizer-paused, authorizer-replay). Insufficient-custody is Foundry-only.
